$comment: D111 §3. Diagnostic and payload entries describe `attrs` of a diagnostic record; audit entries describe `detail` of an audit record (schema/audit.schema.json, spec R1). A group with `open: true` tolerates further keys (legacy HB12 details). The event catalogue; the source of truth for both writers and the reader. Entries carry one full example record each (validated by the tests). Names are stable API (R10): a rename is a new event plus a deprecation.

repeat.description: dedup summary: all occurrences in the window, the first included (§2.9)

link_trace_id.description: a foreign trace id that was not adopted (§2.8)

foreign_message.description: untrusted foreign error text, truncated and redacted by the writer

truncated.description: the value was cut to its limit

bytes.description: original size in bytes when truncated

log_level.description: A level change or its expiry.

log_unregistered.description: An event name that is not in the catalogue.

log_unattributed.description: A line whose source or event does not fit the file it came from.

original.description: the original line, truncated and redacted

expected_source.description: source key the file belongs to

log_redaction_failed.description: A redactor threw; the record was dropped.

attempted_event.description: event name of the dropped record

output_line.description: One wrapped line of third-party output (§2.4).

output_suppressed.description: Output dropped by the per-stream rate limit.

process_event.description: A process or child lifecycle point.

exit_code.description: exit code, null when killed by a signal

signal.description: signal name, null for a normal exit

adoption.description: A running child adopted by a new supervisor.

subscriber.description: A watch subscriber that was dropped.

engine_op.description: A capture or ACL decision in the engine.

ext_load.description: An extension that failed to load.

provider_request.description: An LLM provider request, metadata only (§2.5). Names map to OTel GenAI attributes at export.

retry_after_s.description: seconds the vendor asked to wait

provider_payload.description: A captured payload (payload stream only; content lives in the payload file, never here).

local_model.description: A local model server or in-process model.

channel.description: A channel connection or message (no content).

audit_licence.description: Legacy HB12 `licence.accept-nc` detail (open: further keys are tolerated).

agents.description: null, "all" or a list of agent ids

audit_config_set.description: A configuration change. x-sensitive values are redacted by the writer.

old.description: previous value (any JSON), redacted when x-sensitive

new.description: new value (any JSON), redacted when x-sensitive

audit_secret.description: A secret-store change; never the value.

endpoint.description: collector endpoint, redacted by the URL rule

audit_approval.description: A D109 approval request or decision (mirrored from the store).

store_ref.description: store row id and chain value

audit_grant.description: A D109 grant change (mirrored from the store).

store_ref.description: store row id and chain value

audit_policy.description: A policy denial (mirrored from the store).

store_ref.description: store row id and chain value
store row id and chain value

events.note: A line of child-process output; emitted by the harness wrapper on its behalf, with the level never taken from the text.

events.levelRule: info when planned, error when unexpected, fatal when unexpected for a harness-tier child (§5, R5)

events.note: An engine operation was denied by ACL; diagnostic, not audit (R11).
